findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

1) The hand sink in the back of the facility was without paper towels during this inspection. 2) (REPEAT) The men’s bathroom was missing paper towels. Paper towels were supplied during the inspection to correct. Ensure all handwashing sinks are provided with hot running water, soap, and paper towels at all times.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

An open bag of hot dogs was observed in the walk in cooler without a date. This facility should not be serving any hot food per their risk classification. The hot dog package was likely opened in relation to the 4/10/26 inspection violation and should have been discarded at that time. The PIC was shown and discarded the package during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT from the Pre-Opening) 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

On arrival open boxes of foods were observed on the floor in the walk in freezer. This situation was noted on the previous inspection and is being placed here at this inspection. The PIC was shown and instructed to stored the cases of food on the available shelves moving forward.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.116 Warewashing Equipment, Determining Chemical Sanitizer Concentration. Concentration of the SANITIZING solution shall be accurately determined by using a test kit or other device. 

Only quat test strips are available in the facility and only CL (bleach) sanitizer is available. The situation was discussed and the PIC was instructed to get new test strips prior to the follow-up.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

On arrival there was not a ready for use sanitizer available in the facility. When asked about wiping the counter for coffee or drink spill the PIC indicated that they use a spray Windex cleaner and towel. This is not acceptable and will need to be changed. Education was conduced and a solution utilizing CL was produced to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT from the Pre-Opening) 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

1) Repair damaged cabinet laminate. Exposed particleboard should be sealed. 2) Replace acoustic ceiling tiles over the drinks station and over the back of the soda fountain with smooth easily cleanable vinyl ceiling tiles. 3) Caulk countertops to backsplash at drinks station. These situations were discussed with the PIC and owner at the pre-opening and were reviewed during this inspection. Correct prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT from the Pre-Opening) 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

These items are still in violation from the pre-opening: 1) Clean floors under the back of the soda fountain and under shelving in the walk-in cooler. 2) Clean fan covers in the walk-in coolers. These locations were shown to the PIC and they are instructed to clean these areas and maintain them clean moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Water is observed leaking from the ceiling at two separate locations in the customer area of the building. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to replace the damaged tiles and the ceiling to prevent new damage from accruing.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.citation_text:
3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW.

On the inspector’s arrival the facility had hot dogs on the rollers.  As a Class-III facility this is not allowed. The situation was discussed and the hot dogs discarded to correct. The equipment was turned off. Ensure that the facility is only operating within its classification at all times.
